title: Course policy settings
notice: These settings apply to new enrollments. Existing learners keep the terms they started with; change those with a reviewed policy migration.
zone.hint: Used for absolute deadlines when no window names a zone.
hardDisambiguation.hint: Refusing is the default: a hard deadline never silently lands on a shifted local time.
windowDisambiguation.hint: How a relative window ending on a skipped or repeated local time resolves.
option.compatible: Compatible (later in a gap, earlier in an overlap)
questions.hint: Explanatory questions allowed after an enrollment closes.
feasibility: Feasibility for a learner enrolling now
feasible: The required core path and final assessment fit. Mastery criteria are unchanged.
infeasible: The required core path does not fit this envelope. Mastery criteria are unchanged.
issue.DEADLINE_ALREADY_REACHED: A deadline that binds required work has already passed.
issue.TIME_ENVELOPE_TOO_SMALL: The estimated required work does not fit before this deadline at the declared pace.
issue.TIME_FIT_UNCHECKED: No study pace or work estimate is declared, so only deadlines were checked.
issue.LOOSER_CHILD_DEADLINE: This scope ends after an ancestor; the earlier ancestor deadline binds.
rejected: Some enrollment starts or extensions would be refused at these times. Choose another resolution to avoid that.
rejected.withDetails: Some enrollment starts or extensions would be refused at these times {details}. Choose another resolution to avoid that.
rejected.row: (deadline extensions of {days} {count, plural, one {day} other {days}} in {zone})
